name: EMBRAER S.A.
moat_justification: Narrow-to-moderate aerospace niche moat: Embraer is the only in-production scope-compliant 76-seat regional jet maker (E175) and holds strong executive-jet (Phenom/Praetor) and growing C-390 defense franchises with a record $34.5B backlog and a large installed base feeding Services & Support, but gross margin has stayed thin at 17.3-18.0% in FY2023-2025 (15.7-20.1% over FY2021-2025, fundamentals.json) and returns have not stayed above the cost of capital through a cycle — roic_proxy was negative in 2017, 2019, 2020 and 2022, near zero in 2018, and only strong in FY2023-2025 (17.6% / 23.9% / 25.8%). Scale disadvantage versus Airbus/Boeing, A220 overlap at the top of the E2 range, and the US scope clause blocking the E175-E2 cap the score at 5. CAP 8.5y.

NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

one_liner: Diversified aerospace niche leader, moat 5/10 — does not clear 15% at $72.34: weighted IRR 12.58%, weighted IV@15% $56.46 on a $3.62/ADS normalized OE base; it clears the 15% hurdle only below about $56.46.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: Only in-production scope-compliant 76-seat regional jet (E175) — dominant in US regional fleets with no direct in-production rival in that class
Diversified portfolio across Commercial, Executive, Defense & Security and Services & Support smoothing any single cycle; firm backlog a record $34.5B in Q2 2026 (+16% YoY)
Executive Aviation franchise (Phenom 300 family, Praetor) with Q2 2026 revenue +32% YoY and adj. EBIT margin 23.4%
Installed base of 9,000+ aircraft feeding recurring Services & Support revenue (Q2 2026 +24% YoY, adj. EBIT margin 18.7%)
C-390 Millennium defense momentum (Defense backlog +42% YoY to $6.1B in Q2 2026) and NATO/export adoption
moat_against: Thin, cyclical economics: gross margin only 17.5% in FY2025 and 17.3-18.0% over FY2023-2025; roic_proxy negative or near-zero in 2017-2022 before recovering in 2023-2025 — no through-cycle pricing power proven
Scale disadvantage versus Airbus and Boeing in procurement, financing, support network and program risk-bearing
Airbus A220 (ex-Bombardier) overlaps the E195-E2 at the top of the regional range with Airbus distribution behind it
US scope clauses (76 seats / 86,000 lb MTOW) block the more efficient E175-E2 from the largest regional market; development paused toward 2027-2029
Customer and program concentration, supply-chain / GTF engine exposure, Brazilian political/FX overhang and Eve eVTOL cash burn

overrides.source: Form 20-F for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-30), Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements, capital reserves table (Note 27.5): Sharebased remuneration US$5.4 million in FY2025, US$4.5 million in FY2024 and US$4.5 million in FY2023
